matches.notes: City better most of game; Haaland first PL goal of season; Dean Henderson important saves; Mateta late equalizer. Venue: Selhurst Park.
Liverpool win 3-1; brace from Alexander Isak and free-kick from Dominik Szoboszlai; Forest one on the counter via Morgan Gibbs-White if fit. (Whisper briefly said '1-3-1' then clearly 'finish 3-1'.)
Boring 1-0 away win for Everton; Iliman Ndiaye cut inside and finesse into top corner. Vitality Stadium.
1-0 Coventry; Carl Rushworth masterclass in goal / POTM; Caleb Uranky heading winner from a corner. Building Society Arena (CBS), Coventry. He said 'Hall' (ASR for Hull).
Spurs bounce back after Brentford; Newcastle early counter from Anthony Elanga; then Richarlison and Sandro Tonali (from distance, vs former club). Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Absolute banger; Joao Pedro hat-trick; Brighton two headed goals from corners (Luca Voskiewicz, Lewis Dunk) plus Jack Hinshelwood from outside box; Cole Palmer late winner. Stamford Bridge.
Nil-nil; end-to-end; Trafford and Kelleher great games; Anton Stok hits crossbar from free kick late. Elland Road.
Sunderland destroy Fulham 4-1; braces from Brian Brobbey and Enzo Le Fee; Fulham bright spot Oscar Bob solo goal. Stadium of Light.
Did NOT state an explicit final scoreline. Said comfortable bounce-back win; Cunha getting one and Mbeumo getting two; no Ipswich goals mentioned. Inferred 3-0 from scorers. Old Trafford.

Arsenal win 3-nil at Villa Park. Villa shockingly bad vs Brighton previously; thinner squad / lost Emiliano Martinez. Solis gets two; Gabriel heads one from a corner. (He listed 'Arsenal versus Aston Villa at Villa Park'.)

Liverpool win 4-1 at Portman Road. Early red for Ipswich CB Issa Diop; Isak brace; new signing Bradley Barclas debut goal; Jeremy Jacque header from corner; Ipswich one via Maeda/Pong/Enciso build-up. (He said 'Liverpool vs Ipswich at Portman Road'.)
End-to-end 2-2; Anthony Elanga brace for Newcastle; Ryan and Evanilson score for Bournemouth. St James' Park.
1-1 / one-all; Kelleher saves a Jacque penalty but concedes to Brian Brobbey from outside the box; Igor Thiago penalty for Brentford. Gtech Stadium.
Leeds win 2-1; Dominic Calvert-Lewin opens and gets late winner; Pascal Gross pulls one back for Brighton. Brighton injury crisis noted.
Palace win 1-0; Adam Wharton smash from distance; both sides started with two losses. Craven Cottage. Alvaro Arbeloa start at Fulham called terrible.
Comfortable 3-0 City after they destroyed Palace 4-1; Haaland brace; Ryan Cherki also scores. Etihad.
Forest win 1-0; Morgan Gibbs-White goal. Spurs yet to score after two MDs; continues. City Ground. (Whisper once said '1-1-0' — clearly 1-0.)
Nil-nil; Villa still yet to score after two games; Hull better for most of game / most chances but Zion Suzuki monster game in goal. MKM Stadium. (ASR 'Hall City'.)
Pretty easy 2-0 for Man United; Cunha and Rashford on the scoresheet. Everton squad issues (one striker / one right back). Hill Dickinson Stadium.

Absolute banger / crazy game 3-3 at Emirates. Declan Rice from outside the box; Crystal/Cristian Solis brace for Arsenal; Chelsea front three all score — Morgan Rogers, Cole Palmer, Joao Pedro. Chelsea can score but can't defend.
